roundArtifactContract.acceptance: Only a final exact-SHA SUCCESS for every applicable CI context can qualify a round. Pending/ERROR/FAILURE is not PASS; inherited earlier PASS is scoped only to its exact SHA.
roundArtifactContract.versioning: Do not rewrite previous round conclusions: append a superseding repair receipt referencing the former SHA if needed.
roundArtifactContract.machineMatrix: Only link real test names and verified receipts; do not set Core VERIFIED without every normative obligation and relevant independent semantic authority.

batchAcceptance.partialOrBlocked: If a round remains BLOCKED, keep it BLOCKED with evidence, close no Core, and record remaining dependencies; unrelated rounds may continue.
